about_the_game:
As Darius a former gymnast, platform through perilous environments with only the echoes and remains of your strength. Overcome hazards, master challenges, and rebuild your abilities as you pursue the hooded man who stole everything from you.

  • A simple yet emotional narrative that questions Darius’s beliefs about what truly matters in life and turns his tragic losses into opportunities.

  • A moderately challenging platformer with over 20 clever, unique, hand-crafted levels!

  • Every level is mapped to encourage speed and precision—earn letter rankings based on performance and strive for perfection.

  • Over the course of the story, regain lost abilities that unlock creative, dynamic, movement options that are usable on any stage.

  • Unlock secret, challenging “temple” levels by achieving high letter ranks. These trials will push your skills to the limit and are designed for hardcore platforming veterans.

  • Smooth, simple, and accessible controls—just the left stick and two buttons!

  • A masterfully composed OST with 30+ mind-blowing tracks.

"Loss creates opportunity"
